actions: Search for oak trees in the nearby area.
Break 7 oak log blocks using your hands.
Collect all dropped oak logs until you have 7 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 oak_log.
Craft 4 oak planks using 1 oak log from your inventory.
Craft another 4 oak planks using 1 oak log from your inventory.
Craft a final 4 oak planks using 1 oak log from your inventory.
Verify that you have a total of 12 oak planks in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains at least 4 oak_planks.
Craft 1 crafting_table using 4 oak_planks.
Verify that you have 1 crafting_table in your inventory.
Craft 4 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Craft another 4 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Verify that your inventory contains a total of 8 sticks.
Craft 4 sticks using 2 oak planks at the crafting table.
Verify that your inventory contains a total of 12 sticks.
Discard 3 sticks from your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 9 sticks.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 wooden_pickaxe.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 wooden_pickaxe.
Search for stone blocks in the nearby area.
Mine 11 stone blocks using the wooden pickaxe.
Collect all the cobblestone dropped until you have 11 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 11 cobblestone.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 stone_pickaxe.
Use the wooden_pickaxe to collect 3 cobblestone blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains 3 cobblestone.
Use the crafting_table to craft 2 sticks from the available sticks.
Verify that your inventory contains 2 sticks.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 stone_pickaxe using 3 cobblestone and 2 sticks.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 stone_pickaxe.
Search for coal ore within 128 blocks of your current position.
Mine coal ore using your wooden pickaxe until you have collected 3 coal.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 3 coal.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 crafting_table.
Verify that your inventory contains 8 cobblestone.
Craft 1 furnace using the crafting_table and 8 cobblestone.
Place the newly crafted furnace in your inventory.
Search for iron ore blocks within a reasonable range.
Mine 7 iron ore blocks using the stone pickaxe.
Ensure that you have collected 7 raw iron in your inventory.
Place the furnace on the ground.
Put the raw iron into the furnace.
Add coal to the furnace as fuel.
Wait for the furnace to smelt the raw iron into an iron ingot.
Collect the iron ingot from the furnace.
Repeat the process of smelting raw iron into iron ingots until you have 7 iron ingots in total.
Craft 1 iron_pickaxe using the crafting_table.
Use 3 iron_ingots from your inventory.
Use 2 sticks from your inventory.
Ensure you have enough iron_ingots and sticks in your inventory before crafting.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 bucket.
Ensure you have 3 iron_ingots in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 bucket after crafting.
Search for diamond ore blocks within a range of 128 blocks.
Mine 29 diamond ore blocks using the iron pickaxe.
Collect all the diamonds dropped from the mined diamond ore until you have 29 diamonds in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 29 diamonds.
Search for gravel in the surrounding area.
Collect 1 gravel block using the iron pickaxe.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 gravel.
Break the gravel block to obtain flint.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 flint.
Use the existing bucket in your inventory.
Search for a nearby water source within a reasonable range.
Locate the nearest water block.
Walk to the water block.
Use the bucket on the water block to fill it with water.
Verify that you now have 1 water_bucket in your inventory.
Use the crafting_table in your inventory to craft 1 diamond_pickaxe.
Verify that you have 3 diamonds in your inventory.
Verify that you have 2 sticks in your inventory.
Craft the diamond_pickaxe using the available diamonds and sticks.
Open the crafting table interface.
Craft 1 flint_and_steel using 1 iron_ingot and 1 flint.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 flint_and_steel.
Search for a nearby water source.
Use the bucket to collect water from the water source.
Go to a location with lava.
Use the water bucket on the lava to create obsidian blocks.
Mine 10 obsidian blocks using the diamond pickaxe.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_boots.
Verify that you have at least 4 diamond in your inventory.
Check that the crafting_table is placed nearby.
Ensure that you have 1 crafting_table in your inventory.
Confirm that your inventory contains enough diamonds to proceed with crafting.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_leggings.
Verify that your inventory contains 7 diamond.
Ensure that the crafting_table is placed in the current location.
Collect the necessary 1 crafting_table from your inventory.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_chestplate.
Verify that your inventory contains 8 diamond.
Ensure that the crafting_table is placed in a convenient location.
Open the crafting_table interface to access the crafting grid.
Place 8 diamonds in the crafting grid to create the diamond_chestplate.
Collect the diamond_chestplate from the crafting grid.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_chestplate.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_helmet.
Ensure you have 5 diamonds available in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 diamond_helmet after crafting.
Use the crafting_table to craft 1 diamond_sword.
Ensure that you have 2 diamond and 1 stick in your inventory before crafting.
Verify that your inventory contains the required items: 2 diamond and 1 stick.
Craft the diamond_sword using the available items.
Use the flint_and_steel from your inventory to light the nether portal.
Build the nether portal using the 10 obsidian blocks from your inventory.
Verify that you have successfully constructed 1 nether_portal.
Go to the nearest nether portal.
Use the nether portal to enter the Nether dimension.
Locate a blaze spawner in the Nether.
Approach the blaze spawner carefully.
Engage and attack the nearest blaze until it is defeated.
Collect the blaze rod dropped by the blaze.
Use the blaze_rod available in your inventory.
Craft 1 blaze_powder using the blaze_rod.
Check that you now have 2 blaze_powder in your inventory.
Select the blaze_powder from your inventory as needed.
Search for an enderman in the nearby area.
Approach the enderman carefully without being detected.
Attack the enderman until it drops an ender pearl.
Collect the ender pearl dropped by the enderman.
Use the available ender_pearl in your inventory.
Use the available blaze_powder in your inventory.
Craft 1 ender_eye using the ender_pearl and blaze_powder.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 ender_eye.
